about: Overrides applied by scripts/scene-import.ts (see src/modules/scene/scene-overrides.ts): "buildings" = roof elevation of one building, "hidden" = a GeoPackage building that is not drawn, "parts" = one footprint drawn as several flat-roofed blocks. Remove an entry, or import with --no-overrides, to get the GeoPackage model back. S-MAP is not an independent survey: values here agree with S-MAP, not with a field measurement.

evidence.source: S-MAP 3D viewer mesh surface picks, 2 m grid
evidence.level: source data (one provider), not field verified
evidence.samples: 147 flat roof cells inside the source footprint: median 189.4 m, p10-p90 189.0-191.3 m; roof slab without the parapet band 96 cells 188.8-190.2 m
evidence.footprint: 212 of 216 grid cells inside the footprint are roof (>= 181.3 m); roof edge vs footprint: median offset 0.0 m, 90 % within 0.85 m, max 1.25 m (grid 2 m). The footprint is one high block, not two parts
evidence.crossCheck: same grid, register-height buildings: 한림관 scene roof 196.4 vs mesh top 197.3 m, 본관 154.7 vs mesh median 153.8 m
evidence.replaces: GeoPackage height 14 m ESTIMATE (4 floors x 3.5 m), roof 153.238 m on the server DEM
evidence.notCovered: base, floor count, the low wing south of the footprint (S-MAP 148.8 m, 48 m2, outside the footprint), roof structures up to 193.5 m, vertical datum of S-MAP (one direct comparison, +0.03 m)

hidden.name: 공연실습소
hidden.reason: The polygon carrying the register record 53636 (공연실습소) lies on 혜인관 and is not the 공연실습소 building; the real building is elsewhere (user, 2026-10-10). Its location is not in the campus map yet, so nothing is drawn for it.

evidence.source: user statement 2026-10-10; register AL_D010 record 53636; S-MAP 3D viewer building model, 2 m grid
evidence.level: user-confirmed fact, supported by source data
evidence.register: record 53636 states footprint 570.29 m2, its polygon is 1511.9 m2 and 96 % of it lies on the 혜인관 polygon 42232
evidence.mesh: 364 of 380 grid cells under the polygon are the single S-MAP 혜인관 model (roof median 178.1 m); the 14 cells outside the 혜인관 polygon are open ground (149.1 m). No second volume
evidence.notCovered: the real 공연실습소 (user-marked cluster south-west of 유담관, outside the campus map footprints); campus_buildings still has this polygon as building id 혜인관

evidence.source: S-MAP 3D viewer building model surface picks, 1 m grid
evidence.level: source data (one provider), not field verified; part boundaries read from the grid (+-0.5 m)
evidence.footprint: unchanged: 2896 of 3109 grid cells inside the source footprint are the S-MAP building model, 80 model cells lie outside (max 3.9 m)
evidence.roofs: each part is a flat block at the median of the S-MAP model cells inside it. 1관: 156.8 (p10-p90 155.5-157.8, 919 cells, 99 % within 1.5 m); 2관: 159.7 (p10-p90 158.5-161.0, 935 cells, 97 % within 1.5 m); 2관-낮은단: 146.8 (p10-p90 146.8-155.4, 502 cells, 86 % within 1.5 m); 탑: 162.5 (p10-p90 158.3-162.5, 70 cells, 84 % within 1.5 m); 접합부: 157.6 (p10-p90 152.7-158.6, 275 cells, 64 % within 1.5 m); 접합부-남서날개: 159.2 (p10-p90 157.9-160.4, 42 cells, 93 % within 1.5 m); 동쪽끝-높은부분: 162.0 (p10-p90 162.0-163.0, 65 cells, 88 % within 1.5 m); 동쪽끝-낮은부분: 155.0 (p10-p90 155.0-159.7, 47 cells, 66 % within 1.5 m); 동쪽끝-남쪽날개: 159.0 (p10-p90 157.8-160.4, 41 cells, 95 % within 1.5 m)
evidence.roofForm: 1관: gable in the S-MAP model, eaves 155.3 m, ridge 157.9 m. 2관: one plane rising from 158.3 m (south-west) to 161.3 m at the field edge, beside a 146.8 m flat strip 7 m wide on the south-west side. Tower: 162.5 m flat top, radius 4.8 m, drawn as a 24-gon. Dormers, the antenna mast and roof slopes are not modelled
evidence.replaces: one block, roof 167.627 m (register height 25.5 m on the server DEM median); that is 5.1-20.8 m above the parts
evidence.notCovered: ground heights (S-MAP: field side 148.9 m, west of 1관 127-135 m, south-west of 2관 132.1 m; the server DEM has 141-144 m here), bases, floors, vertical datum of S-MAP
